## Summary

I implemented the disposable-domain blocklist rule in `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`.

**Change** (`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`):
- Added a `DISPOSABLE_EMAIL_DOMAINS` set (`mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`).
- Added `validateEmailDomain(String email)`, which extracts the domain after the last `@` and throws a `400 BAD_REQUEST` (`ResponseStatusException`) when it's on the blocklist. A `null`/absent email is accepted, keeping the field optional.
- Wired the check into the create flow right after email normalization, so the comparison runs against the already-lower-cased email (case-insensitive by construction).

The rule fits the existing pattern of the controller's other 400-emitting validations (postcode, telephone). Full suite: **52 tests, 0 failures**.
